Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one full-body photorealistic baseball batter animation sprite, candidate lower-leg correction, 1024 x 1536 portrait PNG with genuine transparent alpha.
Input image 1 is the ONLY edit target: the approved left-handed precontact pose. Preserve the exact same player, face, body build, realistic skin and woven cloth texture, blue jersey, white pants with thin blue piping, navy helmet, white gloves and navy-white cleats.
Primary request: change ONLY the lower legs and shoes below the knees to narrow the stance by about 20–25%, bringing both shoes inward while maintaining this exact dynamic pre-contact pose. Keep the lead foot (the left-side shoe in the image) planted flat with its toe pointing left. Keep the trail foot (right-side shoe) pivoting on its toe/ball, with the heel naturally raised. Do not make the trail foot float and do not flatten its raised heel.
Source-pixel placement guide on the SAME 1024x1536 canvas: current lead sole spans roughly x52–247 at y1417–1446; move the lead shoe inward to the right about 100px, with heel around x300 and toe around x155–175, preserving its ground height. Current trailing toe is near x889 y1472; bring its toe inward to approximately x770–790 with the SAME ground Y and raised heel. Adjust the lower-leg angles, ankles and trouser folds anatomically to connect naturally to the preserved knees. The two feet must be less widely separated without shortening or stretching any limb.
Invariants: keep every part ABOVE THE KNEES as unchanged as possible, including the exact torso and hip location, diagonal camera angle, shoulders, face and head orientation, helmet, hands and grip, arms, wooden bat orientation and its absolute screen position. Do not recenter, crop, rotate or resize the whole figure. Preserve original player scale and upper-body silhouette. Keep the same warm photographic lighting and sharp high-resolution material detail.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent cutout, no colored or black background, no glow, no vignette, no scene, no ground plane or shadow.
Avoid: illustration or cartoon rendering, 3D mannequin appearance, segmented or jointed puppet limbs, duplicated or missing limbs, reverse joints, warped anatomy, extra bat, logos, sponsor marks, labels, text, jersey numbers, watermarks. Output exactly one complete unsegmented person, a single whole PNG sprite, not a collage or contact sheet.
